cta_paragraph: The jarl, Idgrod Ravencrone, wants the fire investigated. Hroggar's wife and child died, and his quick move into Alva's house has made him an object of suspicion. It's an understandable suspicion, especially in a settlement where the people involved are familiar faces. Yet Hroggar's apparent indifference is also strange enough to deserve a closer look. An investigation has to account for his behavior as well as the burned building. Before we follow Helgi's part in it, you're welcome to subscribe to Forgotten Realms of Sleep and leave a comment saying where you're listening and whether it's day or night there.
